meta.title: Properties Panel
meta.description: A Figma-style properties panel with collapsible sections, typed control rows, and a data-driven or headless API. Powered by shadcn's Input, Select, Switch, and Slider.

blocks.content: Properties panels are the most state-dense UI pattern outside of data tables. Every row is a live two-way binding. The selection changes, the panel updates. The user moves a slider, the canvas updates. Building this by hand means writing a new control component for each property type, managing label alignment across all of them, and wiring collapse state for each group.

The system handles the dispatch. PropertyControl is a discriminated union — set type: 'slider' and the row renders a Slider with a value readout. Set type: 'color' and it renders a swatch that opens a native color picker. The underlying controls are shadcn's Input, Select, Switch, and Slider, which means they inherit your theme, your CSS variables, and your focus styles automatically.

blocks.title: Two modes, same components
blocks.content: Config-driven: pass a sections array and the panel renders everything. Headless: use PropertiesSection and PropertiesRow directly in JSX for full layout control. Both modes are available simultaneously — mix them in the same panel.
Click any section header to collapse it. Edit values — they update live. The color swatch opens a native color picker on click.

steps.title: Add required shadcn components
steps.description: The panel uses Input, Select, Switch, and Slider from shadcn. Add any you haven't installed yet.
steps.code: npx shadcn@latest add input select switch slider

blocks.content: Pass a sections array to PropertiesPanel. Each section has a title, an optional icon, and an array of rows. Each row has a label and a control definition. The panel renders, collapses, and lays everything out automatically.
Use PropertiesSection and PropertiesRow directly when you need layout control, want to interleave custom components, or are building a section that doesn't map cleanly to a rows array.

blocks.title: hidden prop on rows
blocks.content: Pass hidden to PropertiesRow (or set hidden: true on a PropertyRowDef in config mode) to conditionally remove a row without unmounting adjacent rows. Useful for showing controls only when a related toggle is enabled.
PropertyControl is a discriminated union on the type field. Each variant maps to a different shadcn control or native input.

blocks.title: Color uses the native picker
blocks.content: The color control renders a styled swatch that wraps a hidden <input type='color'>. This keeps the system dependency-free — no full color picker is bundled. For a richer color editing experience, use the Palette system's PaletteColorEditor inside a custom control.

rows.description: Config-driven sections. Each section renders its rows automatically.
Headless content. Use PropertiesSection and PropertiesRow directly. Can be combined with sections.
Applied to the panel container. Use to set width (e.g. w-64) and any positioning.
Section label shown in the header button.
Config-driven rows rendered inside the section. Use children for headless rows.
Whether the section is expanded on mount. Collapse state is uncontrolled after mount.
Small icon shown beside the title in the header.
Headless row content. Rendered after any config-driven rows.
Applied to the section wrapper.
Property name shown on the left. Truncated at 80px.
The control definition. See PropertyControl below.
Removes the row from the DOM. Use for conditional controls without affecting adjacent row layout.
Applied to the row wrapper.
Discriminant field. Determines which control renders and which other props are available.
Current value. Type depends on the control: string for text/color/select, number for number/slider, boolean for toggle.
Called with the new value on every change. Not present on type: 'custom'.
type: 'number' only. Shown after the input (e.g. 'px', '%', 'ms').
type: 'number' and type: 'slider'. Passed to the underlying input or Slider.
type: 'text' only. Input placeholder text.
type: 'select' only. The select options.
type: 'custom' only. Renders inside the control cell with no wrapper.
